subject: Correction: exact retention fields in previous render plan
body: The previous message lost two backticked identifiers in shell expansion. Exact proposal: for generic TGJ1 jobs only, key Dispatch.compositorTextures[31] and Dispatch.compositorSamplers[16] retention by the plan native binding index (0..15), not by Metal slot. No shared struct change requested. Existing compositor/R85 paths keep Metal-slot indexing. All other content of the previous message stands. Request compute/textures/lowering ACK or objection.
